Criterion: Verify that drainage and ventilation provisions are located so that combustibles are removed from the air vehicle to a safe location on the ground and cannot reenter the air vehicle in flight or ground operations. Standard: The location of the drained fluids and vapors is such that they do not reenter the air vehicle or impinge on potential ignition sources under all operational conditions. Adequate drainage paths exist and are not prone to blockage. Method of Compliance: Analysis demonstrates that the location of the drained fluid does not reenter the air vehicle or impinge on potential ignition sources under all operational conditions. Manufacturing and inspection processes and procedures are in place to assure there are no blockages of drainage paths. Ground and flight tests demonstrate the removal of flammable fluids to a safe location.
